procurement_roots_not_additive_with_memb.note: One catalogue kit is the purchase accounting root; actual owned stock/purchase unverified. Ring remains one physical installed member, never an additional ring order.

remove_from_old_BOM.item: M4 flat washer OD9 ID4.3 t0.8 at old Y-54.8

replacement_delta.reuse_old_washers_for_new_positions: Possible only after actual part suitability check; CAD moves/replaces the washer instances and does not leave old washers stacked in place. No extra four retained washers may be counted.

non_double_count_rules: ci_cable, co_wire and cr_wire are displayed segments of one continuous core, not three purchased wires.
The Ø5 input ball is the core factory end, not another purchase.
The M4 slotted clamping screw is included in the nipple assembly; no assumed-length extra grub screw is ordered.
The housing inner liner belongs to housing-with-liner; it is not a second standalone hose.
Complete-kit root and its steel core/ball/housing/ferrules/adjusters/nipple/M6-nut members are alternative accounting levels, not additive purchase lines.
Manufacturer component-category list does not establish included quantities; required two adjusters/two ferrules/four M6 nuts must not be assumed fully covered by one kit.
HCDG8-30 and supplied NETW7 each have one physical occurrence; input-axis-pin-kit is the only purchase root for that pair. The E-clip clearance-space mesh is not another component.
The special capture washer remains separate from the four ordinary M4 host mounting washers; there are no ordinary M4 axis washers in this adopted axis.

open_items.detail: Output cap source models M3x16 shaft and D5.5 H3 head without a drive recess or explicit drive designation; two output screws remain a distinct extraction row. Current assembly-selection layer can independently choose DIN912/ISO4762 and its tool; this extractor does not infer a recess from a cylinder or invalidate that explicit selection.
No selected/owned kit SKU or verified per-kit component counts; no final core/housing cut length. Stored1000/1200 catalog option is not an installation cut list.

HCDG8-30 catalogue pair includes NETW7; engineering adoption is not actual seating/retention-load/tool acceptance. E-clip R10 and Z budget are engineering requirements, not guaranteed installed ring CAD. No central M4 bolt/nut/distance tube remains. POM-C bush is a machined design requirement, not a PETG print or supplied item; thrust washer is a catalogue ID10 configuration, not purchased stock.
Nominal CAD sizes do not select vendor, thread engagement quality, grade, torque or locking. No unrecorded manufacturer proof is invented.

Ferrule bearing depth, crimp details, nipple screw length/drive/torque and wire holding force remain open. Modeled tail8 mm below nipple center /5.5 mm outside body is an installation maximum, not supplier minimum tail.
